# Reduce (GDA reduce) and SameQuantum (IEEE 754-2008 clause 5.7.3). Reduce
# removes trailing zeros as far as MaxExp allows; a zero reduces to the
# zero of its sign at exponent 0; specials are canonicalized. Both are
# exact and take no mode.

# --- Reduce64 ---

Reduce64 - exact 2.1 -> 2.1
Reduce64 - exact -2.0 -> -2
Reduce64 - exact 1.200 -> 1.2
Reduce64 - exact -120 -> -1.2E+2
Reduce64 - exact 120.00 -> 1.2E+2
Reduce64 - exact 1000000 -> 1E+6
Reduce64 - exact 1E+16 -> 1E+16
Reduce64 - exact 1.000000000000000E+16 -> 1E+16
Reduce64 - exact 9999999999999999 -> 9999999999999999
Reduce64 - exact 2.50 -> 2.5
Reduce64 - exact 1234567890123456 -> 1234567890123456
Reduce64 - exact 1.0E+2 -> 1E+2
Reduce64 - exact 0.000100 -> 0.0001
Reduce64 - exact 10E+368 -> 1E+369

Reduce64 - underflow 1E-398 -> 1E-398
Reduce64 - underflow 100E-398 -> 1E-396
Reduce64 - underflow 1.0E-397 -> 1E-397
Reduce64 - underflow 9.99999999999999E-384 -> 9.99999999999999E-384
Reduce64 - underflow 1.000000000000000E-383 -> 1E-383

Reduce64 - clamp 1.00E+371 -> 1.00E+371
Reduce64 - clamp 1.000E+371 -> 1.00E+371
Reduce64 - clamp 1E+369 -> 1E+369
Reduce64 - clamp 1.0E+370 -> 1.0E+370
Reduce64 - clamp 1.000000000000000E+384 -> 1.000000000000000E+384
Reduce64 - clamp 9.999999999999999E+384 -> 9.999999999999999E+384
Reduce64 - clamp 1.20E+370 -> 1.2E+370

Reduce64 - zero 0.00 -> 0
Reduce64 - zero -0E+5 -> -0
Reduce64 - zero -0.00 -> -0
Reduce64 - zero 0 -> 0
Reduce64 - zero 0E-398 -> 0
Reduce64 - zero 0E+369 -> 0
Reduce64 - zero -0E+369 -> -0

Reduce64 - inf Infinity -> Infinity
Reduce64 - inf -Infinity -> -Infinity

Reduce64 - nan NaN -> NaN
Reduce64 - nan -NaN -> NaN
Reduce64 - nan sNaN -> NaN
Reduce64 - nan -sNaN -> NaN
Reduce64 - nan 0x7c00000000000001 -> NaN
Reduce64 - nan 0xfe0000000001e240 -> NaN

Reduce64 - noncanon 0x6c77ffffffffffff -> 0
Reduce64 - noncanon 0xec9fffffffffffff -> -0
Reduce64 - noncanon 0x6c7386f26fc10000 -> 0
Reduce64 - noncanon 0x77ffffffffffffff -> 0
Reduce64 - noncanon 0x7c038d7ea4c68000 -> NaN

# --- Reduce128 ---

Reduce128 - exact 2.1 -> 2.1
Reduce128 - exact -2.0 -> -2
Reduce128 - exact 1.200 -> 1.2
Reduce128 - exact -120 -> -1.2E+2
Reduce128 - exact 120.00 -> 1.2E+2
Reduce128 - exact 1.000000000000000000000000000000000E+34 -> 1E+34
Reduce128 - exact 9999999999999999999999999999999999 -> 9999999999999999999999999999999999
Reduce128 - exact 10E+6110 -> 1E+6111

Reduce128 - underflow 1E-6176 -> 1E-6176
Reduce128 - underflow 100E-6176 -> 1E-6174
Reduce128 - underflow 1.000000000000000000000000000000000E-6143 -> 1E-6143

Reduce128 - clamp 1.00E+6113 -> 1.00E+6113
Reduce128 - clamp 1.000E+6113 -> 1.00E+6113
Reduce128 - clamp 1E+6111 -> 1E+6111
Reduce128 - clamp 9.999999999999999999999999999999999E+6144 -> 9.999999999999999999999999999999999E+6144
Reduce128 - clamp 1.000000000000000000000000000000000E+6144 -> 1.000000000000000000000000000000000E+6144

Reduce128 - zero 0.00 -> 0
Reduce128 - zero -0E+5 -> -0
Reduce128 - zero -0.00 -> -0
Reduce128 - zero 0E-6176 -> 0
Reduce128 - zero 0E+6111 -> 0

Reduce128 - inf Infinity -> Infinity
Reduce128 - inf -Infinity -> -Infinity

Reduce128 - nan NaN -> NaN
Reduce128 - nan -NaN -> NaN
Reduce128 - nan sNaN -> NaN
Reduce128 - nan 0x7c000000000000010000000000000000 -> NaN
Reduce128 - nan 0xfe000000000000000000000000000005 -> NaN

Reduce128 - noncanon 0x3041ed09bead87c0378d8e6400000000 -> 0
Reduce128 - noncanon 0xb047ed09bead87c0378d8e6400000000 -> -0
Reduce128 - noncanon 0x6c100000000000000000000000000000 -> 0
Reduce128 - noncanon 0xe0000000000000000000000000000001 -> -0
Reduce128 - noncanon 0x77ff800000000000000000000000007b -> 0

# --- SameQuantum64 ---

SameQuantum64 - exact 1.0 2.0 -> true
SameQuantum64 - exact 1.0 1 -> false
SameQuantum64 - exact 1 2 -> true
SameQuantum64 - exact 1E+2 100 -> false
SameQuantum64 - exact 1.5E+3 2.5E+3 -> true
SameQuantum64 - exact 1E+369 9.999999999999999E+384 -> true
SameQuantum64 - exact 1.0 1.00 -> false

SameQuantum64 - underflow 1E-398 2E-398 -> true
SameQuantum64 - underflow 1E-398 1E-397 -> false
SameQuantum64 - underflow 1E-398 0E-398 -> true

SameQuantum64 - zero 0 0.0 -> false
SameQuantum64 - zero 0E+5 -0E+5 -> true
SameQuantum64 - zero 0 -0 -> true
SameQuantum64 - zero 0 1 -> true
SameQuantum64 - zero 0E+369 0E-398 -> false

SameQuantum64 - inf Infinity -Infinity -> true
SameQuantum64 - inf Infinity Infinity -> true
SameQuantum64 - inf Infinity NaN -> false
SameQuantum64 - inf 1 Infinity -> false
SameQuantum64 - inf Infinity 0 -> false

SameQuantum64 - nan NaN sNaN -> true
SameQuantum64 - nan NaN NaN -> true
SameQuantum64 - nan -NaN NaN -> true
SameQuantum64 - nan NaN 1 -> false
SameQuantum64 - nan 0x7c00000000000001 NaN -> true
SameQuantum64 - nan NaN Infinity -> false

SameQuantum64 - noncanon 0x6c77ffffffffffff 0 -> true
SameQuantum64 - noncanon 0xec9fffffffffffff 5E+5 -> true
SameQuantum64 - noncanon 0xec9fffffffffffff 0 -> false
SameQuantum64 - noncanon 0x6007ffffffffffff 1E-398 -> true
SameQuantum64 - noncanon 0x77ffffffffffffff 1E+369 -> true

# --- SameQuantum128 ---

SameQuantum128 - exact 1.0 2.0 -> true
SameQuantum128 - exact 1.0 1 -> false
SameQuantum128 - exact 1E+6111 9.999999999999999999999999999999999E+6144 -> true

SameQuantum128 - underflow 1E-6176 2E-6176 -> true
SameQuantum128 - underflow 1E-6176 1E-6175 -> false

SameQuantum128 - zero 0 0.0 -> false
SameQuantum128 - zero 0E+5 -0E+5 -> true
SameQuantum128 - zero 0 1 -> true

SameQuantum128 - inf Infinity -Infinity -> true
SameQuantum128 - inf Infinity NaN -> false
SameQuantum128 - inf 1 Infinity -> false

SameQuantum128 - nan NaN sNaN -> true
SameQuantum128 - nan NaN 1 -> false
SameQuantum128 - nan 0x7c000000000000010000000000000000 -NaN -> true

SameQuantum128 - noncanon 0x3041ed09bead87c0378d8e6400000000 0 -> true
SameQuantum128 - noncanon 0xb047ed09bead87c0378d8e6400000000 5E+3 -> true
SameQuantum128 - noncanon 0x6c100000000000000000000000000000 1E+1 -> false
SameQuantum128 - noncanon 0xe0000000000000000000000000000001 1E-6176 -> true
